name: Hinkley Xero watcher: bill exception checks (read-only)

parameters.content:
## Hinkley Xero watcher (read-only exception checks)
Reads supplier bills (ACCPAY) from every connected Xero organisation and emails Ruel and accounts@ a digest of exceptions. It changes nothing in Xero.
**Before activating**
1. Select your existing **Xero OAuth2** credential on the three Xero HTTP nodes. It must be authorised for all five organisations.
2. Select the Outlook credential on **Send digest to Ruel**.
3. Edit **Config**: `digest_to` (comma-separated list of recipients), `property_tracking_category` (the Xero tracking category that holds the property; to be agreed with Jenny), and the thresholds (placeholders): `dup_window_days` (looser duplicate rule), `vat_rates` (allowed VAT %), `old_bill_days`.
4. Run **Manual test** once, then activate. The first run looks back `lookback_hours`; later runs ask each organisation only for changes since its last successful check.
Memory (last check, issues already reported) is workflow static data, saved only on active runs, not on manual tests.
Xero Starter tier: 5 connections and 1,000 calls per organisation per day. This workflow makes 2 calls per organisation per run, plus one more for each extra page of 100 bills (up to 10 pages per query; keep `xero_max_pages` in Config equal to "Max pages" on the two Xero bill nodes).

**Overlap with Route A:** Route A already checks property coding on DRAFT and SUBMITTED bills and emails its own [New invoice record]. So the watcher skips its missing_property check for those statuses (`route_a_statuses` in Config) and reports it only for approved bills. All other checks still run on every bill. Set `route_a_statuses` to empty to check every bill again.
